title: Study Aimed At Improving Height With Genotonorm In Children Born Little And/Or Light With Growth Retardation At The Age
brief_summary: To estimate the percentage of children with serum IGF-1 \> 2 standard deviation (compared to a child of the same gender and age and without growth hormone (GH) deficiency) 9 months and 12 months after initiation of GH treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Chronological age between 4 and 9 years for a boy and 4 and 7 years for a girl.
* Measured Height \< -2.5 Standard Deviation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pubertal signs ie: testis volume \> or = 4 ml in boys and breast stage \> or = B2 (Tanner)
* Serious chronic disease (diabetes, renal insufficiency, heart failure, hepatic insufficiency, neoplasia)
